prompt:
Create one complete animation source-frame spritesheet for Lumina Nang Am - Sprout Form, using the provided front-facing MASTER image as the strict identity source.

Output exactly one transparent PNG spritesheet, not separate files. Layout: 5 columns x 6 rows, thirty equal cells. Every cell contains one 1024x1024-style source frame composition. No text, no labels, no row titles, no numbers, no captions, no contact sheet labels, no checkerboard, no background, no accessories, no external effects. Real alpha transparency only.

Character identity, preserve strictly in every cell: tiny cute chibi forest sprout spirit pet; very round fluffy cream-colored body; warm amber-brown eyes; tiny orange nose; cute small mouth; soft peach blush cheeks; tiny rounded paws; small fluffy side arms; glowing heart-shaped mark on the chest; exactly two fresh green sprout leaves growing on top of the head. Baby/seedling form of Lumina Nang Am: soft, innocent, warm, cozy, fluffy, plant-themed. Do not add antlers. Do not add big leaf tails. Do not evolve it into Stage 1. Do not make it a deer form. Do not add accessories. Do not change species or redesign the character.

Global animation rules: keep character mostly front-facing, same canvas size, same ground position, stable body registration across all cells, readable at 128px, cute cozy mobile pet animation, soft baby sprout spirit. Registration stability is more important than dramatic motion. Only visible source pose changes, no repeated timing holds.

Body stays mostly front-facing; no food objects; drool small and adorable, not gross.

Style: same as master render, cute cozy mobile pet source frames, soft hand-painted chibi fantasy, warm cream and green palette, gentle shadows and highlights, clean silhouette, no harsh neon, no realism, no pixel art, no heavy black outlines.
